While it involves antigen enrichment, it does not fit the specific PTM-based modifiers (like phospho or ubiquitin) listed in the ontology. The proteomics mode is explicitly stated as Bottom-up in PRIDE metadata.

scope: Antigen-specific F(ab’)2 was enriched by affinity chromatography against recombinant SARS-CoV-2 S-2P or RBD protein cross-linked to NHS-activated agarose resin (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

Total IgG was isolated from patient serum using Pierce Protein G Plus Agarose (Pierce Thermo Fisher Scientific) and cleaved into F(ab’)2 fragments with IdeS protease. Antigen-specific F(ab’)2 was enriched by affinity chromatography against recombinant SARS-CoV-2 S-2P or RBD protein cross-linked to NHS-activated agarose resin (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

Proteomic Ig-SEQ identification of SARS-COV-2 specific antibodies from serum of two convalescent patients during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic. Total IgG was isolated from serum, digested with IdeS protease to generate F(ab)2 fragments, and subjected to antigen affinity chromatography using agarose beads coupled with SARS-COV-2 spike protein.
